title: Practice 6: Антон Чехов · Анна на шее

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: «Как он мил, когда ___ (трезвый)!» — думала она.
exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: ___ (держаться) он солидно, движения у него были не быстрые, манеры мягкие.
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: Через нее я ___ (мочь) получить старшего докладчика!
exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Голова у тебя не ___ (отвалить / отвалиться).
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Он ___ (улыбаться / улыбнуться) своими маленькими глазками.
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: «ввиду только что сказанного», а бедный Петр Леонтьич страдал от унижения и испытывал сильное желание ___ (выпить / пить).
exercises.why: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action.

exercises.q: Мягкие движения его пухлого тела ___ (пугать / испугать) ее, ей было и страшно, и гадко.
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Через нее я могу ___ (получить / получать) старшего докладчика!
exercises.why: Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect; some have other changes: **читать** — **прочитать**, **получать** — **получить**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect;…

exercises.q: Он ___ (встать / вставать), не спеша снял с шеи орден, снял фрак и жилет и надел халат.
exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).
